newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK protester in lone vigil outside Ziang's hotel.
newsitem.headline: HK protester in lone vigil outside Ziang's hotel.

text.p: A lone protester stood outside the hotel of China's President Ziang Zemin on Monday, holding up the picture of a man killed in the 1989 Tiananmen square demonstrations and shouting Premier "Li Peng is a murderer".
The protester, who identified himself as Lu Si Qing, stood across from the luxury Harbour Plaza hotel where Jiang and his entourage, including Li, were staying.
"Release all the political prisoners," Lu shouted as Jiang's motorcade sped into the hotel.
Jiang came to Hong Kong to accept the handover of the colony from Prince Charles, ending 156 years of British rule.
Heavy security was laid on around the hotel amid concerns by officials that Hong Kong's active pro-democracy movement could try to upstage the handover ceremony with protests.
